# New features and enhancements

## Manage client portals in Funnel AI and Funnel MCP (30 October)

You can now create and manage client portals from a conversation in Funnel AI, or in Claude, ChatGPT, and other clients connected to Funnel MCP. For example, ask Funnel AI to create a portal for a client with your paid media dashboards and the client's branding.

​

You can also:

​

- Add, remove, and organize dashboards in a portal.

- Rebrand a portal.

- Check who has access to a portal.


**Note**:

​

- You can't invite or remove portal users from a conversation yet. The assistant shows who has access and links you to the **Portals** page to make changes.

- You can't upload brand logos from a conversation yet. When you edit a brand, it keeps its current logo.


To get started, read:

​

- [Manage client portals in Funnel AI](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17779421-manage-client-portals-in-funnel-ai)

- [Manage portals and brands using Funnel MCP](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17780136-manage-portals-and-brands-using-funnel-mcp)


​

## View conventions in Funnel AI and Funnel MCP (30 October)

You can now explore your conventions in Funnel AI and through Funnel MCP. Ask the assistant to:

​

- List your active and archived conventions.

- Open a convention to see its patterns, allowed values, and the dimensions it generates.

- Link you to an active convention in Funnel for the full setup.


​

Use it to check how your campaign names become dimensions without leaving your conversation. Read how to [view conventions using Funnel MCP](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17780332).

​

## Create and manage exports in Funnel AI and Funnel MCP (29 October)

You can now set up a scheduled export from a conversation in Funnel AI, or in any client connected to Funnel MCP. For example, ask to export cost by connector for the last 30 days to BigQuery every day at 6 AM. The assistant finds the fields and your connection, and shows you the destination, fields, dates, and schedule. In Funnel AI, select **Create and run** on the approval card. In Funnel MCP, approve the change in the conversation. The first run starts right away.

​

You can create exports to:

​

- **Google Sheets**: A tab in a new or existing spreadsheet. Funnel replaces the tab on every run.

- **BigQuery**: A date-partitioned table in your own Google Cloud project. Funnel writes it in monthly parts.

- **Snowflake** (Funnel MCP only): A table in an existing database in your Snowflake account.

- **Google Cloud Storage**: Gzipped CSV files in your own bucket, one file per month.


​

You can also manage your existing exports from the conversation:

​

- List your exports and see what an export contains, including Looker Studio, Tableau, and Power BI views.

- Turn an export on or off.

- Run an export now, optionally for specific dates.

- See every destination you can send data to, and which ones you need to set up in Funnel instead.


​

The assistant can also show the data behind an export to help you analyze it. By default, every change waits for your approval. In Funnel AI, you can set creating, turning on or off, and running exports to **Always allow** in **AI** \> **Tool permissions**, so they happen without an approval card.

**Note**:

​

- Include the **Date** dimension in BigQuery, Snowflake, and Google Cloud Storage exports.

- The account you connect needs write access to the project, database, or bucket. If the table or files don't appear, check the run status on the export's page in Funnel.

- You can't create Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI views from a conversation. Set them up in Funnel.


To get started, read:

​

- [Manage exports in Funnel AI](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17779419)

- [Manage exports using Funnel MCP](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17780138)


​

## Conditional scheduled tasks (29 October)

You can now make a scheduled task conditional. The task runs on its schedule as usual, but only sends you an email or Slack message when a condition you set is met. Use it to monitor, for example, cost or ROAS below a threshold, spend above a budget, or a data source that stopped delivering data.

​

When the condition isn't met, the run history shows **Nothing to report**, with a short note of what Funnel AI checked.

​

To create one, tell Funnel AI something like "every morning, email me only if…". If you create the task manually, state the metric, period, and threshold in the prompt.

**Note**: Be specific. Funnel AI can evaluate a condition such as "if cost per brand for yesterday is below 5,000 SEK", but not "if cost looks too high". A task only checks data Funnel has already imported, so a daily schedule usually works best.

Read how to [schedule tasks](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17664432-schedule-tasks) in Funnel AI.

​

## Check Flexpoint usage using Funnel MCP (29 October)

You can now ask Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other clients connected to Funnel MCP about your subscription's Flexpoint usage. Try prompts such as "How many Flexpoints do we have left?" or "Which connectors use the most Flexpoints?". The assistant can show:

​

- Total usage: Flexpoints used, your plan's capacity, and how many are left.

- Usage by workspace.

- Usage by connector and destination, split into setup and account Flexpoints.


​

The assistant only shows what you can already see in Funnel. Subscription members can see total usage. To see usage by workspace or connector, you need the subscription admin or owner role.

​

Read how to [check Flexpoint usage using Funnel MCP](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17780141).

​

## Manage data sources in Funnel AI and Funnel MCP (29 October)

You can now work with your data sources from a conversation in Funnel AI, or in any client connected to Funnel MCP, such as Claude or ChatGPT. You can:

​

- Add a data source. Pick the connector, connection, account, and data source template in the conversation.

- Rename a data source, pause or resume its downloads, or exclude it from your Funnel data.

- Reconnect a data source to another connection, or switch its template.

- Delete a data source, and restore it within 31 days.


​

By default, nothing changes until you approve the exact change in the conversation. In Funnel AI, you can set renaming and restoring data sources to **Always allow** in **AI** \> **Tool permissions**, so they happen without an approval card. You get the same access as in Funnel, so the assistant only offers connectors your workspace can use. If you aren't signed in to a connector yet, you get a link to sign in through Funnel.

**Note**: The assistant uses only Funnel's preset data source templates. To use your own template, set up the data source in **Data** \> **Connect** \> **Data sources**.

To get started, read:

​

- [Manage data sources in Funnel AI](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17779420-manage-data-sources-in-funnel-ai)

- [Manage data sources using Funnel MCP](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17780139-manage-data-sources-using-funnel-mcp)


​

## Funnel AI keeps working when you leave (28 October)

Funnel AI now finishes its answer even if you navigate away, reload the page, or close your browser. The chat history shows which chats are still running and marks chats with a new answer. You get a notification when a task is done or needs your input.

**Note**: To let Funnel AI finish without stopping for approvals, set actions to **Always allow** under **AI** \> **Tool permissions**, or select **Always allow** on the approval card.

## Funnel AI can run code (28 October)

Funnel AI can now write and run Python code to do further calculations on your Funnel data, such as finding outliers or calculating predictions. Funnel AI still uses Funnel's data platform when it can, and uses code when it needs more advanced analysis. The code runs in an isolated environment with no internet access.

​

Funnel AI shows the results of these calculations in the conversation, for example as tables. You can't save charts of these results to a dashboard. Read the [introduction to Funnel AI](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/12920015-introduction-to-funnel-ai) to learn more.

​

## Create custom fields using Funnel MCP (28 October)

You can now create custom dimensions, metrics, and formula metrics from any client connected to Funnel MCP, as you already can in Funnel AI. The assistant prepares the field and shows a preview with sample values. Funnel saves the field only after you approve it.

​

Read how to [create custom fields using Funnel MCP](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17780140).

​

## Databricks export is generally available (26 October)

You can now make your Funnel exports available in Databricks. The export uses the Delta Sharing protocol, with a setup flow tailored to Databricks.

​

This feature is available on Business and Enterprise plans, and during trials. Read how to [export to Databricks with Delta Sharing](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15419235-databricks-export-with-delta-sharing).

​

## Measurement AI insights in chat (23 October)

Insights in the Measurement app now open in the Measurement AI chat. Previously, insights appeared as cards above the performance report. Now, the insights come from the same source as the chat, and you can ask follow-up questions about them.

​

## Measurement tools in Funnel MCP (22 October)

You can now use Funnel Measurement tools through Funnel MCP in Claude and ChatGPT, without a manual connection. The tools are available if your subscription has the Measurement add-on. Funnel MCP uses the same Measurement permissions you have in Funnel.

​

Read how to connect Funnel MCP to your client:

​

- [Connect Funnel MCP to Claude](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15170890)

- [Connect Funnel MCP to ChatGPT](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/16522580)


​

## Snowflake export with Delta Sharing is generally available (21 October)

You can now access your Funnel exports as read-only tables in Snowflake through Delta Sharing. You query the shared data from Snowflake, and Funnel doesn't write to your Snowflake account.

​

Use this option when your policies don't allow Funnel to write to your Snowflake account. Otherwise, use the regular Snowflake export, which writes tables to your own Snowflake account and gives you more control over your data.

​

Read how to [export to Snowflake with Delta Sharing](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15798521-snowflake-export-with-delta-sharing).

​

## PostgreSQL export is generally available (20 October)

The PostgreSQL export is out of beta. You can now export your Funnel data to a PostgreSQL database, including managed services such as Supabase.

​

This feature is available on Business and Enterprise plans, and during trials. Read how to [set up a PostgreSQL export](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17663881-postgresql-export-guide).

​

## Saturation curves in their own tab (16 October)

Saturation curves in the Measurement app now have their own **Saturation curves** tab. You can:

​

- Compare as many sources as you want in one chart.

- Zoom in on your spend level by setting how far beyond your maximum spend the chart extends.


​

The curves now pass through your current CPA or ROAS. Funnel calculates the marginal CPA in the performance report from the same point, so the numbers match.

​

## Manage tool permissions in Funnel AI (15 October)

You can now decide which Funnel AI actions need your approval. Go to **AI** \> **Tool permissions** and set each action, such as updating dashboards or creating custom fields, skills, or scheduled tasks:

​

- **Always allow**: Funnel AI goes ahead without asking.

- **Ask each time**: Funnel AI asks for approval first. This is the default.

- **Never allow**: Funnel AI doesn't take the action.


​

You can also select **Always allow** on an approval card, so you don't need to approve that action again.

**Note**: Tool permissions apply only to you and only to the current workspace. Set them again in each workspace you use.

Read how to [manage tool permissions in Funnel AI](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17779418).

​

## Klar connector (14 October)

You can now connect Klar, an e-commerce attribution and analytics platform, to Funnel. Get order, revenue, new and returning customer, cost, session, and customer lifetime value data at channel, campaign, ad group, and ad level.

​

You can choose from eight attribution models and four attribution windows when you set up the data source.

​

Read the [Klar: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/17757661-klar-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Updated charts in Measurement AI chat (12 October)

Charts in Measurement AI chat now look like charts in the Measurement app. You can download a chart from the chat and add it to a presentation without further editing.

​

## Funnel AI in a sidebar and new navigation (7 October)

Funnel AI chat now opens as a sidebar next to the page you're working on, on every page in your workspace. You can use the chat and the rest of Funnel side by side. Funnel's navigation is also updated.

​

## Business Performance tab (6 October)

You can now open the **Business Performance** tab in every Measurement app. Use it to review overall marketing performance next to channel, source, and campaign results.

​

The tab includes:

​

- Year-over-year trends for **Spend**, **Revenue**, **Conversions**, and **Blended CPA / ROAS**

- Correlation charts for **Spend** and **Revenue**, and for **Spend** and **Conversions**


​

## Expanded chart filters (2 October)

You can now use more operators when you filter metrics on a dashboard chart. Previously, a chart metric filter supported only **Greater than zero**. You can now include or exclude rows inside a numeric range.

​

You can also group chart filter conditions with OR, as you can in dashboard filters and the **Fields & filters** panel.

​

# Updates on dimensions and metrics

## Google Ads: Search Keyword report updates (28 October)

The **Search Keyword** report now includes AI Max rows that aren't attributed to a keyword, at ad group and campaign level.

​

You can also get two new keyword status dimensions:

​

- **Ad Group Criterion Status**

- **Approval Status**


​

Read the [Google Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/1933427-google-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Pinterest: New reach and frequency metrics (28 October)

You can now get more reach and frequency metrics from the Pinterest connector:

​

- 30-day reach at ad group level

- 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day reach and frequency at Pin promotion level


**Note**: To get these metrics, add them to your data source configuration.

Read the [Pinterest: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/2678860) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## TikTok Ads: Video ID for Spark and Smart+ ads (28 October)

The **Video ID** dimension now contains the TikTok post ID for Spark and Smart+ ads that don't use a video from the Asset Library. This applies to data sources with **Creative video URLs** selected. Existing data sources need a new download to fill in the post IDs.

​

The value matches the video ID in the TikTok Organic connector. You can join paid ads with organic posts, for example to get the caption and video share URL from TikTok Organic.

​

Read the [TikTok Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/3675555-tiktok-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## TikTok Ads: New metrics in the Smart+ Creative report (27 October)

You can now get submit application metrics for website and offline events in the **Smart+ Creative** report:

​

- **Submit application count (website)**

- **Total submit application value (website)**

- **Submit application count (offline)**

- **Total submit application value (offline)**


​

Funnel also calculates cost per submit application, submit application rate, and value per submit application for website and offline events.

​

Read the [TikTok Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/3675555-tiktok-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Pinterest: New metric (27 October)

You can now get the **Ad Group CPA goal** metric from the Pinterest connector.

​

Read the [Pinterest: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/2678860) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Facebook Ads: New metric (26 October)

You can now get the **Instagram Follows** metric from the Facebook Ads connector.

​

Read the [Facebook Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/1981284-facebook-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Google Ads: New dimension and metric (15 October)

You can now break down the **Landing Page** report by **Device**.

​

You can also get the **Store Visits (Location Asset)** metric in the standard report. It shows the estimated number of visits to your business after a click or impression, based on location asset data.

​

Read the [Google Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/1933427-google-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Google Merchant Center: New report (15 October)

You can now get the **YouTube Product Tagged** report from the Google Merchant Center connector.

​

New dimensions:

​

- **Offer ID**

- **Title**

- **Product type**

- **Currency**


​

New metrics:

​

- **Clicks**

- **Impressions**

- **Views**

- **Orders**

- **Gross sales**

- **Net sales**

- **Commissions**

- **Tagged video count**

- **Tagged creator count**

- **Conversion rate**


**Note**: This report isn't enabled by default. Contact your Funnel representative to enable it for your workspace.

Read the [Google Merchant Center: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/4387210-google-merchant-center-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Magento 2: New report (15 October)

You can now get refund data from the new **Credit Memos** report in the Magento 2 connector. Select **Credit Memos** in the report selector on a new or existing data source.

​

New dimensions:

​

- **Credit Memo Created At**

- **Currency**

- **Record Type**

- **Credit Memo ID**

- **Credit Memo Order ID**

- **Credit Memo Store ID**

- **Credit Memo Store View**

- **Credit Memo Item SKU**

- **Credit Memo Item Name**

- **Credit Memo Item Order Item ID**

- **Credit Memo Item Product ID**


​

New metrics:

​

- **Credit Memo Grand Total**

- **Credit Memo Item Qty Refunded**

- **Credit Memo Item Price**

- **Credit Memo Item Row Total**


**Note**: Your Magento admin role needs the `Magento_Sales::sales_creditmemo` permission.

Read the [Magento 2: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/4792460-magento-2-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Google Ads: New metrics and dimension (14 October)

You can now get two new metrics in the standard report at campaign, ad group, ad, and asset group level:

​

- **Orders**: Purchase conversions attributed to your ads. Available only when your conversions include cart data.

- **Original Conv. Value**: Conversion value from biddable conversions before value rules or lifecycle goals are applied.


​

The **Shopping Performance** report has a new **Device** dimension for shopping campaigns and ad groups, and a new **Max CPC Bid (Ad Group)** metric for ad groups that use Manual CPC bidding.

**Note**: **Original Conv. Value** isn't available when you select **Device**, **Click Type**, or **Ad Format Type** as an optional dimension.

Read the [Google Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/1933427-google-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## TikTok Ads: New metrics and creative previews (14 October)

You can now get 42 new event metrics in the **Basic** report, including onsite, interactive add-on, engagement, view-through attribution, TikTok Shop, messaging, and click metrics.

​

Creative previews are also improved:

​

- Ad data sources now download the cover image and playable video for Basic auction ads, whether or not **Creative video URLs** is selected.

- Spark Ads created from organic posts now have cover images and playable video previews.


**Note**:

​

- Most of the new event metrics aren't available when you select **Country Code** under **Additional Dimensions**.

- For Spark Ads previews, the advertiser must give Funnel access to the post's video information.

- Carousel and photo posts don't have previews yet.


Read the [TikTok Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/3675555-tiktok-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Pinterest: New dimensions and metric (14 October)

You can now get ad group optimization goal fields from the Pinterest connector, such as **Ad Group Optimization Goal Conversion Event**, **Ad Group Optimization Goal Is ROAS Optimized**, attribution window days, and the **Ad Group Optimization Goal CPA Goal Value** metric.

​

Read the [Pinterest: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/2678860) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Naver: New report (14 October)

You can now get the **Bizmoney Exhaust** report from the Naver connector. It shows daily refundable and non-refundable spend by campaign type and product.

​

New dimensions:

​

- **Settlement Timestamp**

- **Settlement Date**

- **Product Info Code**

- **Activity Code**


​

New metrics:

​

- **Refundable Amount**

- **Non-Refundable Amount**


​

Read the [Naver: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/4579323) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Display & Video 360: New dimensions and creative previews (14 October)

You can now get two new dimensions in every report row that has a **Creative ID**:

​

- **Media IDs**: The IDs of all image, video, and text assets in the creative.

- **Media URLs**: The URLs of all assets in the creative.


​

Image and display creatives now also have image previews in Funnel.

​

You can also add the **Gender (Targeted)** dimension to custom reports. Custom reports with this dimension previously failed.

​

Read the [Display & Video 360 custom reports: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/2948491-display-video-360-doubleclick-bid-manager-custom-reports-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Amazon Seller Central: New reports (14 October)

You can now get two new reports from the Amazon Seller Central connector:

​

- **Inventory Ledger - Summary View**: Inventory movements and warehouse balances by ASIN, FNSKU, and MSKU. Aggregate by country or fulfillment center, and by day, week, or month.

- **Order Item Details - Updated At**: The same fields as the **Order Item Details** report, with the Funnel **Date** set to when the order item was last updated instead of the order date. This captures changes made outside the refresh window.


**Note**:

​

- In the **Order Item Details - Updated At** report, an order can have several rows, one for each update after the order date.

- These reports aren't enabled by default. Contact your Funnel representative to enable them for your workspace.


Read the [What data can I get from Amazon Seller Central?](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/6258578-what-data-can-i-get-from-amazon-seller-central) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Amazon DSP: New report (14 October)

You can now get the **Audience** report from the Amazon DSP connector. It shows cost, delivery, conversion, video, and off-Amazon metrics by audience segment, together with campaign, ad group, line item, and order details.

**Note**:

​

- A metric can be attributed to several segments. Analyze the data one segment at a time.

- This report isn't enabled by default. Contact your Funnel representative to enable it for your workspace.


Read the [Amazon DSP: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/7150919-amazon-dsp-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## OpenAI Ads: New optional breakdowns (14 October)

You can now break down the **Insights** report by **Country**, **Device**, or **Platform**.

**Note**: **Conversions** isn't available when you break down by **Platform**.

Read the [OpenAI Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/16440456-openai-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## CJ Affiliate: New dimensions (12 October)

You can now get the **Brand ID** and **Brand** dimensions from the CJ Affiliate connector.

​

Read the [CJ Affiliate: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/4783750-cj-affiliate-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## LinkedIn Ads: Creative images restored (8 October)

Creative images from the LinkedIn Ads connector are available again. Funnel now matches images by both **Creative ID** and **Campaign ID**, which improves image matching.

​

Read the [LinkedIn Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/1989948-linkedin-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## WooCommerce: New dimensions and metrics (6 October)

You can now get Order Attribution fields from the WooCommerce connector. These order-level dimensions and metrics show the device, session, and UTM data WooCommerce stored for an order.

​

New dimensions:

​

- **Device Type**

- **Session Entry**

- **Session Start Time**

- **Source Type**

- **UTM Source**

- **Referrer**

- **UTM Medium**

- **UTM Term**

- **UTM Content**

- **UTM Campaign**


​

New metrics:

​

- **Session Count**

- **Session Pages**


​

Read the [WooCommerce: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/4966407-woocommerce-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

**Note**: These fields are opt-in. During data source setup, set **Include Order Attribution** to **Yes**. The default is **No**. Funnel includes these fields only when that option is **Yes**. If you already connected WooCommerce with **No**, connect a new data source and set **Include Order Attribution** to **Yes**.

## OpenAI Ads: New reports (2 October)

You can now get conversion data from the OpenAI Ads connector with two reports: **Conversions** and **Conversion Events**. Both reports are available at campaign, ad group, and ad level. You can break results down by **Country** or **Device**. The default is no breakdown.

​

**Conversions** metrics:

​

- **Conversions**

- **Click-through Conversions**

- **View-through Conversions**

- **Attributed Sales**


​

**Conversion Events** adds the **Event Name** and **Event Kind** dimensions, plus these metrics:

​

- **Event Count**

- **Event Click-through Conversions**

- **Event View-through Conversions**

- **Event Value**

- **Event Value Count**


​

For each data source, set **Attribution time basis** to **Ad event time** or **Conversion time**, **Click attribution window** to 7, 14, or 30 days, and **View-through attribution window** to 0 or 1 day.

​

Read the [OpenAI Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/16440456-openai-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## StackAdapt: New breakdown (1 October)

You can now use the **DMA** breakdown in the **Insight** report. It adds the **DMA** dimension, the number of the United States Designated Market Area, which maps to Funnel's **DMA Region** dimension.

​

Read the [StackAdapt: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/4579552-stackadapt-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.
